slides.h1: App Store Connect stuff nobody warns you about.
slides.lead: The code was done. Then came the forms. Prep these before launch week.

slides.h2: Your privacy label must match your app.
slides.lead: Apple asks what data you collect and why. Answer it honestly — and keep it in sync with your privacy policy.

slides.h2: Login wall? Give the reviewer a way in.
slides.lead: If the reviewer can't sign in, they can't review. Add working demo credentials.
A real page with a real way to contact you. Not a placeholder.
Apple asks for specific device sizes. Design them once, properly, before submission day.
Inviting people outside your team goes through beta review. Build in time for it.

slides.h2: Launch week is paperwork week. Start early.
